buckets.description:
List of right, inclusive bounds for the buckets to use. Implied left-most boundary of 0.
For example, if this field is [0.33, 0.67, 1.00], then the buckets are: [0, 0.33], (0.33, 0.67], (0.67, 1.00].

categories.description: List of labels corresponding to the buckets. Categories and buckets are matched by index.

colors.description: List of colors (assumed to be hex) to use for the groupings. Colors and buckets are matched by index.

title: Type to define the a color grouping scheme for scatter plot.
name: ScatterPlotChartColorGroupingSpec
